title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: Nonprofit Partner and Municipal Partner tier verification basis
content:
Enrollment into the Nonprofit Partner tier of the Corporate Wellness Partnership requires documented nonprofit status under applicable nonprofit-organization documentation, for any tier configuration where that documentation is required. Enrollment into the Municipal Partner tier requires a government contract reference number, for any tier configuration where that reference is required. Both of these are verified against a documented headcount-verification basis for the tier rather than against the employer's own self-reported statement.

Whether nonprofit documentation is required for the Nonprofit Partner tier, whether a government contract reference is required for the Municipal Partner tier, and which verification basis (self-attested or documented) applies to each tier, are stated in a separate document.
